# DOUGHBOX (13 · doughbox)

A very serious bakery with gooey canvas blobs, sticker prices, and a live oven schedule.

- **Technique:** GOO & SPRINGS
- **Tags:** playful, food, bakery, colorful, friendly, cute, pastel, bouncy
- **Best for:** bakeries & cafes; food brands; kids products; playful consumer brands
- **Fonts:** Baloo 2, Nunito
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Baloo+2:wght@500;600;700;800&family=Nunito:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #fff3df · #f7a6c1 · #ffd166
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/doughbox/` (Template.astro, art.ts, content.ts, goo.ts, meta.ts, oven.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Signature effects
- `art.ts`
  - `pastrySvg`
- `goo.ts`
  - `initGoo(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement)` — Gooey background blobs: seven radial-gradient discs that drift on sine paths and spring toward the pointer. Under reduced motion a single frame is painted (and repainted on resize).
- `oven.ts`
  - `markNowSlot(slots: HTMLElement[], hour = new Date()` — Highlight the slot baking right now. Each `.slot` carries its start hour in `data-hour`; a slot runs until the next one starts (the last until midnight). Before the first slot of the day, the first one is highlighted.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<i>/<br>/<span>/<a> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Thick-outline pastry illustration drawn above a menu card. */
export type PastryArt = 'croissant' | 'donut' | 'roll' | 'loaf';

/** Palette token behind a menu card's tag pill. */
export type TagTone = 'butter' | 'berry' | 'sky' | 'mint';

export interface MenuItem {
  /** Sticker price in the card's top-right corner. */
  price: string;
  art: PastryArt;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  /** Pill under the description. */
  tag: string;
  tagTone: TagTone;
}

/** One entry of the daily oven schedule. */
export interface OvenSlot {
  /** 24-hour start time as "H:MM", e.g. "7:00". The slot lasts until the next slot starts (the last until midnight). */
  time: string;
  what: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  brand: {
    /** Emoji (or short text) in the logo's boxed badge. */
    mark: string;
    name: string;
  };
  /** Nav links before the order button. */
  nav: Link[];
  /** Pill-shaped order button at the end of the nav. */
  orderCta: Link;
  hero: {
    /** Pulsing status pill above the heading. */
    badge: string;
    /** Wrap the bobbing words in `<span class="berry">` / `<span class="butter">`. */
    headingHtml: string;
    sub: string;
    cta: Link;
    /** Small italic line under the button. */
    note: string;
  };
  /** Scrolling ticker; the items repeat endlessly, each followed by the separator. */
  marquee: { items: string[]; separator: string };
  menu: {
    /** Anchor id of the section (nav links target it). */
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    heading: string;
    items: MenuItem[];
  };
  hourly: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    heading: string;
    /** Sticker on the slot that is baking right now (local time). */
    nowLabel: string;
    schedule: OvenSlot[];
  };
  promise: {
    id: string;
    quoteHtml: string;
    cite: string;
  };
  footer: {
    noteHtml: string;
    /** Credit line; the showcase line is appended on showcase routes. */
    creditHtml: string;
  };
}
```
